adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent, `selectedCalendar` is computed as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else-branch), the `.find()` predicate compares `cal.externalId` to `externalCalendarId` (i.e., `undefined`/`null`), so it will not match any real calendar externalId and returns `undefined`. This makes the fallback effectively dead/broken and can lead to attempting an update without a valid calendar id (or at least not selecting the intended destination calendar). The same faulty pattern is also introduced in deleteEvent.
